programme.sub-title: The Hunt for Outlaw Bill Doolin
programme.desc: When notorious outlaw Bill Doolin escapes from jail, the U.S. Marshals Service springs into action to end his four-year crime spree. Known as the Three Guardsmen, Deputy U.S. Marshals Heck Thomas, Bill Tilghman, and Chris Madsen have a reputation for always getting their man, but they know it won't be easy with Doolin. Doolin is no ordinary outlaw: as a former member of The Dalton Gang and the mastermind of The Wild Bunch, he has successfully robbed banks, trains, and stagecoaches. After months of tracking Doolin, Heck Thomas is so close he barely stops to eat or sleep. When Thomas and his posse finally corner Doolin, he refuses to surrender, and gunfire is the only way out. Mary soon discovers that the Western Frontier satisfies her free-spirited nature, and she decides to stay in Montana for good. She secures a contract to deliver mail by stagecoach for the U.S. Postal Service, becoming the first African American woman to carry mail. With a fearless attitude and multiple firearms, she protects the mail from would-be bandits and is soon known far and wide. programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into the dangers of teenage sex and underage drinking -- and how three families have been affected. In Part 2 of his exclusive interview, the 16-year-old girl who claims high school football star Matt and three other classmates raped her at a party opens up about what she says happened that night. Why does she say her peers care more about the accused football players than they do her? Don’t miss Matt and his parents’ reactions to what she has to say. Then, Leah alleges that in 2011, her 15-year-old daughter, Rehtaeh, was raped by four classmates at a party, and that after nearly a year-and-a-half of relentless bullying, the teen took her own life. How could this have been prevented? And what message does Leah have for others in similar situations? Plus, hear from Alexis, who says she too was raped at 15 and “could’ve been Rehtaeh.” What does she say got her through her darkest moments? Don’t miss this powerful cautionary tale for every teen and parent! This program contains strong sexual content.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Change My Face, Change My Race
programme.desc: Most everyone has thought about removing imperfections: a nip here, a tuck there. But what about people who want plastic surgery to erase their ethnic identity? Dr. Phil gives his take on divisive racial issues.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Follow a dad, John Clark's journey as he searches for his missing family.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tony Fort was just 10 years old when he says a man his mother trusted to watch him began grooming him, brainwashing him, and sexually abusing him. Tony says he was vulnerable and lonely, and he believed the older man was his best friend. Tony claims the man gave him dangerous, addictive drugs, telling him it was candy, and videotaped Tony being sexually abused. The man even followed Tony’s family when they moved to a new state, and he eventually abducted Tony. Authorities say they believe he had a sinister and dark plan for the little boy. Today, Tony speaks out for the first time about what happened to him.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman endures nearly two decades of severe abuse, allegedly inflicted by her adoptive parents.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Today, an exclusive interview with Tonia Bales, the first wife of the infamous con artist “Dirty John” Meehan. Tonia shares the details of her 10-year marriage for the first time with Dr. Phil and discusses her new podcast available on Audible, The First Wife: John Meehan’s Reign of Terror. She is later joined by the second wife of Meehan, Debra Newell, who says she survived an emotionally abusive relationship with the known con man. Debra has returned with a positive update and to talk about her new book, Surviving Dirty John: My True Story of Love, Lies and Murder. Then, hear from Debra’s daughter Terra Newell, who says she was a victim of “Dirty John” Meehan in a violent attack. She ​is also called a hero by many, as she was the one who ​fatally stabbed John Meehan in self-defense.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is a wife really secretly hacking her own family?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The honeymoon is over! Dr. Phil talks with newlyweds about their troubles, and he and Robin share some stories of how they make their marriage work.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Losing the friendship of your closest confidant can be as painful and devastating as a divorce. Michele and Christy were best friends for 20 years, but times have changed. Michele says Christy went behind her back and married her fiancé and father of her son! Christy says Michele has now brainwashed her stepson against her. Concerned for the 10-year-old boy caught in the middle, can Dr. Phil broker a peace between the former BFFs? And, Britney and Ashley’s friendship took a bad turn when Britney decided not to name Ashley the godmother of her newborn son. After the snub, Ashley sent Britney hundreds of texts and e-mails to try to work things out, but Britney feels harassed and says she’s not interested in reconciliation. Learn the appropriate boundaries for maintaining healthy friendships and the signs that a friendship has turned toxic.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil works with three young couples in relationships.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A newlywed wife does not trust her husband. Plus- a follow-up with popular past Shamika and Marlon.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tracy says her daughter, Ashley, 22, and Ashley’s boyfriend, Andrew, 23, are freeloaders who are living rent-free in her home, while she pays all of their expenses. She says they sleep all day and have let her beautiful suburban home turn to filth. Tracy says she accepts blame for allowing the situation to spiral out of control -- learn the one mistake she says she regrets the most. Ashley and Andrew deny the accusations and say they work part-time for Tracy’s business, and they’ve earned everything she's given them. See what happens when Dr. Phil cameras enter the home. Dr. Phil gets real with Ashley and Andrew -- and Tracy. Can he get through to them? Then, Lorrie and Todd say that their 13-year-old-daughter controls their home. The parents admit that they just can't seem to say no to the teen, who they say throws tantrums and manipulates them until she gets her way. Lorrie and Todd say they prepare special meals for her and cut her food -- and it’s putting a strain on their marriage. Dr. Phil shares his insight and devises a plan to get this family back on track. Plus, tune in to find out the three tips you must know to ensure you're not spoiling your child.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of Shanda Sharer who was murdered confronts one of the convicted killers.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil takes goes inside the unthinkable: making your own child sick to fulfill a disturbing need for attention. The idea might sound unimaginable, but for people with a psychological disorder called Munchausen by Proxy, it's irresistible. Note: Viewer discretion is advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are deadbeat dads actually dead broke dads? As the American economy struggles, men comprise most of the recent layoffs. In child support cases, are men and women treated equally in the courts, or are the laws out of touch with today's crisis? Dr. Phil's guests, along with Mel Feit, director of the National Center for Men, and Lis Wiehl, author and legal analyst, debate the issue that has many men feeling like the laws are against them.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are we raising a generation of ungrateful children? Melissa’s sisters say her sons are the most spoiled boys in North America. They get everything they want – all they have to do is whine. Melissa says her kids just like toys, and she thinks her sisters may be jealous of her lifestyle. Next, Dori admits that her 13-year-old son, Parker, is spoiled. Parker says he won't take no for an answer, and even has a strategy for getting everything he wants. Find out what's behind Dori's need to spoil Parker. Then, Joan says her 14-year-old daughter, Jacquie, is a snob, and her need for trendy clothes is turning her into a materialistic monster. Plus, Lauren spends her entire paycheck shopping, but with no money in her checking account, she’s afraid she could be headed for trouble. Her mom, Diane, says she's not worried, it's just Lauren's way of relaxing.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They’re self-absorbed, spoiled and entitled brats, otherwise known as Generation Me. MTV correspondent Kim Stolz recently hit the streets of New York to find out how the younger generation feels about this label. Don't miss the candid responses. Then, Bradley, 24, says he wants to be rich and drive a Lamborghini, but he only wants to put in 80 percent of the effort. He still relies on his mom, Christine, to pay his rent and other bills. Will Bradley learn to stand on his own two feet? Plus, Monica says her 18-year-old daughter, Courtney, is an “entitlement princess,” and she gives the teen money just to keep the peace. Will mom and daughter get a wake-up call? And Jean Twenge, author of Generation Me, reveals why many young people are narcissistic.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is it asking too much for your 20-something child to make his or her own money and live independently? Barbara says her daughter, Chelsea, needs to grow up! She says she’s given her daughter nothing but the best, and all she has to show for it is a lying child who won’t speak to her. Chelsea says she can’t live up to her mom’s “rich bitch” expectations and just wants to be left alone. Mother and daughter see each other on the Dr. Phil stage for the first time in seven months, and sparks fly! Is Barbara surprised to learn the secret Chelsea reveals? Then, Chelsea’s grandmother isn’t immune to her granddaughter’s conniving ways. Learn why she feels used. And, Barbara says Chelsea has spent thousands of dollars of her family’s money, and anytime she earns her own, she spends it and doesn’t pay her family back. Dr. Phil conducts an experiment to see what the young woman will do with $500. You may be surprised by the results!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Two moms ask Dr. Phil to give their sons a reality check. Rita says her son, Eric, changed his name to “King Keith” and is forgoing a college education to pursue a singing career. Has he lost touch with reality? And, Cheryl says her college-educated son, Patrick, is lazy and lacks ambition.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Cherylyn says she loves living the high life and admits she is a spoiled and entitled“princess”who has spent tens of thousands of other people’s money on her lavish lifestyle. Cherylyn says she maxed out her 19 credit cards on designer shoes, handbags, purses, clothes, makeup and pampering! And, Cherylyn says she insists on fine dining, fast cars and her boyfriend, Tyler, footing the bill. However, Tyler says he has nothing more to give Cherylyn except an ultimatum, which he delivers when he comes face-to-face with her onstage. Cherylyn's mom, Joey, says that her selfish and manipulative daughter has blown over $130,000 in less than a year and her spending has left a trail of devastation which includes pawning over $7,000 worth of family heirlooms and stealing her identity. Sparks fly when Cherylyn defends her entitled behavior during the taping. What jaw-dropping statement does an unrepentant Cherylyn make to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nina says even after she lowered her 15-year-old daughter, Nicolette’s, monthly allowance from $5,000 to $1,000, Nicolette is still overspending on her credit cards in order to keep up with teens in their hometown of Beverly Hills. Nina says she recently allowed a family friend, Joel, to move into her home so he could help chauffeur Nicolette around and watch her spending. Nicolette admits to spending her day having lunch in Beverly Hills, shopping, and making YouTube videos. Nina and Joel say they worry about Nicolette, who admits to having zero future goals except to not work, be rich, wear designer clothes and drive a Mercedes G-Wagen. Dr. Phil surprises Nicolette, her mother, and Joel by sending Nicolette on a special assignment near Skid Row in downtown Los Angeles a few days prior to taping Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Taal
programme.desc: Mansi, a gifted singer from a humble background, rises to fame and is caught between two powerful men Manav, her first love, and Vikrant, her mentor. The film explores love, ambition, and social class, all set to A.R. Rahman's iconic music.

programme.title: Iqbal
programme.desc: Iqbal is an inspiring sports drama about a young boy (played by Shreyas Talpade) who is deaf and mute but dreams of playing cricket for the Indian national team. With the help of a reclusive former cricketer (Naseeruddin Shah), he trains rigorously, battling societal prejudices, family pressure, and systemic challenges. Directed by Nagesh Kukunoor, the film is a heartfelt celebration of determination, dreams, and triumph against adversity. It’s widely appreciated for its emotional depth and uplifting narrative.

programme.title: Jodi No.1
programme.desc: Directed by David Dhawan, this comedy features Sanjay Dutt and Govinda as Jai and Veeru, partners in crime who flee to Goa and impersonate rich businessmen. Their plan to marry into wealth backfires hilariously as they fall for the daughters of their target, leading to a series of misadventures.

programme.title: Awarapan
programme.desc: Directed by Mohit Suri, Awarapan stars Emraan Hashmi as a tormented hitman working for a crime lord. When he's assigned to monitor his boss's mistress, he begins to question his life choices, leading to a path of self-discovery and redemption. The film is an uncredited remake of the South Korean movie A Bittersweet Life.

programme.desc: What a journey it's been over the last three weeks! We kicked off our adventure in Eastern Sears Creek, making our first casts to see what the waters would yield. From there, we headed to South Lake for some laid-back pontoon trout fishing. After a relaxing day by the lake, complete with apple pie and cold beverages, we followed expert advice from Jared to venture back into the heart of nature. Our trek led us to Long Lake, nestled just above South Lake, offering more stunning views and fishing spots. Today on Stoked on Fishing, we're picking up where we left off. programme.title: Best of Morning Footy
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.desc: Sandy, upon discovering her husband's infidelity while watching her son's birthday video, leaves the suburbs and moves into the city. She gets an apartment that's above a coffee house where she befriends one of the workers, Aram, a guy whose wife only married him so she could get a green card. Aram's family thinks he's wasting his life and education by working in the coffee house. Soon after moving into the apartment, Sandy hires Aram to be her nanny while she takes on work for the first time since her children were born. It isn't long when Aram and Sandy find they get along wonderfully and start to date. But the question is: is their relationship real or is it, in fact, just a rebound for both of them?

programme.desc: In Ohio, police discover a young woman lying near railroad tracks - a railroad spike plunged in her head. She dies a few hours later. In northern California, a young woman never makes it home after visiting loved ones. Authorities find her broken down car and determine she was last seen with a deadly fugitive. Without any clues to her whereabouts, investigators turn to psychic Kathlyn Rhea for guidance.

programme.desc: Richard investigates claims that the supposed mastermind behind the 9/11 terrorist attacks and leader of the Al Qaeda terrorist cell remained a CIA asset until his death. programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: Surf Abu Dhabi Pro 2025
programme.desc: The WSL Championship Tour makes its groundbreaking debut in the Middle East at the 2025 Surf Abu Dhabi Pro. The second stop on the CT marks professional surfing's continued global expansion and also establishes Abu Dhabi as an official surf destination. Engineered for excellence, this high-performance wave will provide a canvas for the world's best surfers set against a stunning backdrop of the Arabian Gulf. The event will showcase not only the remarkable evolution of professional surfing beyond its traditional roots, but also the infinite possibility for progression from athletes like rookie Erin Brooks, former World Champion Italo Ferreira, and reigning World Champ Caity Simmers.

Relive Final's Day action as the world’s best fire the Championship Tour back up. The 2025 Tour starts NOW.

programme.title: All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour
programme.sub-title: Can Julian Wilson Keep His Winning Momentum Going in Portugal? | All In Ep5
programme.desc: While Julian Wilson and Jordy Smith head to Portugal for the MEO Rip Curl Pro Peniche, Carissa Moore and Lakey Peterson travel home to relax for a month before having to compete in the final event on the women's WSL World Tour season, the Beachwaver Maui Pro. After his win in France, Julian needs a good result in Portugal to have a chance at the men's world title. For Jordy, Portugal is a chance to let loose and charge. For every surfer, this is the most critical point in the world tour season, as the Hawaiian leg looms on the horizon.

As the third stop on the 2025 World Surf League Championship Tour, this event is crucial for competitors looking to build momentum in their World Title campaigns.

programme.title: All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour
programme.sub-title: Life Inside The World Tour Pressure Cooker With Kanoa Igarashi And Steph Gilmore | All In S2EP1
programme.desc: Welcome back to Season 2 of All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour, the series that steps inside the minds and lives of some of the best surfers in the world. This season we follow rising star Kanoa Igarashi and seven-time world champ Stephanie Gilmore in the pressure-filled months of the 2019 season’s "fourth quarter," as the ultra-competitive athletes battle it out contest to contest, balancing their personal lives with the professional demands of competing at the highest levels.

programme.desc: Bells Beach on Victoria's South Coast is the longest-running surfing competition and will host the 62st edition this year. Bells is Australian surfing heritage. With the hope of scoring long-period, groomed walls, the surfers will need to display the perfect combination of power, precision, and timing. The biggest surfing legends have had the honor of winning and ringing ‘The Bell' and 2025 will see a hungry new generation vying for the opportunity to cement their names in one of surfing's most prestigious events.

programme.desc: Sam, Easkey, and Adrien catch up with West African surf legend Oumar Seye, the first West African sponsored surfer. Seye has impacted the surf culture in Senegal in more ways than one, both proving the sport can be more than a hobby and supporting sustainability by banning plastic bags at his surf events. They end their trip in Popenguine, a bohemian beach town where an incredible women-led initiative to plant thousands of trees has made the area one of the greenest parts of the country.

programme.title: WSL Replay

programme.desc: The Western Australia Margaret River Pro is the 7th stop on the 2025 World Surf League Championship Tour. Margaret River brings raw power, pumping waves and unforgettable drama.

programme.title: WSL Inside Pro Surfing
programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing - Lexus WSL Finals Fiji presented by Corona Cero 2025
programme.desc: After nine regular season events, the Lexus WSL Finals brings the top 5 men and top 5 women in professional surfing to Lower Trestles for a one-day, winner-take-all, showdown for the coveted title of World Champion. From Pipeline and Portugal to Teahupo'o and Cloudbreak, it has been a hard fought season for the world's best surfers. Ten surfers enter, and only two will emerge as Champions and add their name to the legacy of the sport.

programme.desc: As Carissa Moore, Lakey Peterson, and the rest of the women of the WSL World Tour arrive to Honolua Bay, Maui, so too does one of the biggest swells in recent memory. programme.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

programme.desc: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show

Using interviews with top researchers, skeptics, independent thinkers and authors, Syrett is determined to uncover the truth to some of the most extraordinary claims of conspiracy.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Negan y sus hombres atacan a las tres comunidades rebeldes al mismo tiempo. Sin Rick, Carl asume la defensa de Alexandria, cercada por el propio Negan. Mientras, Simon detiene al ejército de Hilltop en la carretera y Gavin quiere capturar a Ezekiel.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carl hace una última petición a Rick y Michonne antes de morir. Mientras tanto, Morgan y Carol intentan rescatar a Ezekiel antes de que Gavin se lo entregue vivo a Negan para que este lo torture y asesine delante de sus seguidores.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Negan ordena a Simon que mate solo a uno de los hombres de Jadis como escarmiento, pero Simon tiene sed de venganza. Mientras, Rick se dirige al basurero del grupo de Jadis para renovar su alianza, y Aaron sigue intentando obtener un acuerdo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: A Maggie se le acaban las reservas de alimentos y debe decidir si deja que los presos pasen hambre. Mientras, Daryl guía a los supervivientes de Alexandria a través de un pantano repleto de zombis, y la adversidad pone a prueba la fe de Gabriel.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick ataca a Negan cuando este se dirigía a Hilltop y terminan enfrentándose en un edificio abandonado, pero Simon y Dwight siguen el rastro de Negan. Mientras tanto, Maggie, Enid, Michonne y Rosita discuten sobre la propuesta de una desconocida.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.sub-title: No nos lleven por el mal camino
programme.desc: Los Saviors, ahora dirigidos por Simon, atacan Hilltop pese a que algunos de sus combatientes están dentro, presos. Maggie organiza la defensa del poblado pero, ¿podrán evitar una masacre como la que Simon perpetró contra el grupo de Jadis?

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Jadis planea una muerte horrenda para Negan. Mientras, Morgan va en busca de Henry y Rick sale de Hilltop para cazar a los que huyeron durante el asalto comandado por Simon. Finalmente, los dos se encuentran en territorio enemigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras los hombres de Negan continúan con su ofensiva, Aaron sigue buscando aliados nuevos, pese a que pueda costarle la vida. Daryl y Rosita se enfrentan a un viejo amigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Las comunidades unen sus fuerzas en la última batalla contra los Salvadores. Negan ha conseguido entregar a Rick un mapa con instrucciones mapas, para así tenderle una emboscada.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick y su grupo hacen un viaje arriesgado a Washington, D. C. para buscar los artefactos que necesitarán para construir la civilización que él y Carl imaginaron.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Las comunidades se unen para restaurar un puente que facilite la comunicación y el comercio, pero alguien resulta gravemente herido. Además, varios Saviors han desaparecido.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Una desaparición misteriosa pone en peligro los planes para el futuro de Rick y divide al grupo mientras construyen un puente.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La visión de Rick de un futuro civilizado se ve amenazada por un cúmulo de traiciones y agravios pasados que nunca fueron vengados ni perdonados.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick se ve obligado a enfrentar el pasado en su intento por proteger a las comunidades y el futuro que Carl y él concibieron.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Seis años después de la desaparición de Rick, un grupo recién llegado a Alexandria, liderados por la temperamental Magna, genera problemas a los habitantes de la comunidad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Eugene está solo y en peligro, perseguido por una horda de zombis que, aparentemente, hablan. Mientras tanto, Michonne guía al grupo de Magna hasta Hilltop, donde esperan ser aceptados como nuevos miembros de la comunidad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl, Jesus y Aaron encuentran a Eugene, pero la horda de zombis parlantes los persigue incansablemente. Entretanto, en Alexandria, Negan escapa de su confinamiento porque a Gabriel se le olvida cerrar la puerta de su celda.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los grupos individuales están convencidos de que pueden construir un futuro mejor por separado, pero la pérdida de un miembro los lleva a unir fuerzas. Se revela una amenaza perturbadora y peligrosa.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl libera a Henry porque le estaba contando demasiadas cosas a Lydia y, después, interroga a la adolescente sobre su grupo. Entetanto, el grupo de Magna desobedece a Tara y se adentra por la noche en el bosque en busca de Luke.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo de salvajes que lidera Alpha ataca Hilltop para recuperar a su hija. Mientras tanto, una misión en busca de suministros se convierte en una lucha entre la vida y la muerte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Henry encuentra a Lydia, pero Beta, la mano derecha de Alpha, lo captura. En Alexandria, Michonne discute con el consejo si deben participar en la feria con el resto de las comunidades.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl, Connie, Henry y Lydia se ocultan en un edificio para tenderle una trampa a Beta. Mientras tanto, el Reino sufre la amenaza de un grupo de extorsionistas que patrulla las carreteras y exige dinero a cambio de transitar por ellas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Se descubre el espeluznante origen de las misteriosas cicatrices que Michonne y Daryl lucen en la espalda, el motivo por el cual la actitud de Michonne hacia los forasteros cambió tanto desde la desaparición de Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Por primera vez en años, las cuatro comunidades se reúnen durante la feria que organiza el Reino. Alpha aprovecha la ocasión para infiltrarse de incógnito entre los visitantes de la feria.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Se desata una tormenta de nieve terrible que sorprende al grupo de Ezekiel viajando hacia Hilltop. Su única esperanza reside en cruzar la frontera que estableció Alpha y acortar el trayecto a través del territorio que tienen prohibido pisar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En Oceanside, el grupo continúa entrenando en caso de que los Susurradores regresen. Las tensiones aumentan, mientras los supervivientes tratan de aferrarse a lo que queda en pie de su concepto de civilización.

programme.desc: The most remote state in the U.S. never disappoints - from the rapids of Aniakchak, to the “white thunder” of Glacier Bay, to the sled dogs of Denali. Join Colton and Jack as they revisit their most epic and wild Alaskan adventures.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S10 E01 - 48 Hours In Basque Country NB
programme.desc: Travel Man is back, with new host Joe Lycett presenting the definitive guide to 48 hours away in some of the most exciting short to medium haul destinations on Earth. For the first trip of his debut series, Joe is joined by comedian James Acaster for a long weekend in the Spanish part of the Basque Country, where they visit a bargain two cities for the price of one!

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S10 E02 - 48 Hours In Split NB
programme.desc: Joe Lycett presents the definitive guide to a fast and funny 48 hours away. This week he visits the Croatian City of Split with comedian, actress and writer, Aisling Bea.

programme.title: DW Euromaxx At Its Best
programme.sub-title: Euromaxx At Its Best E04 - Portugal At Its Best
programme.desc: Discover the fascination of Portuguese tile art in the capital Lisbon, stroll with us through the streets of Porto and marvel at the paradisiacal nature of Madeira and the Azores.

programme.title: DW Euromaxx At Its Best
programme.sub-title: Euromaxx At Its Best E05 - Great Britain At Its Best
programme.desc: Decide with us whether London really is as beautiful as the pictures on Instagram. Find out why Harry Potter is so important to Edinburgh, meet the only four-legged mayor in the world and have an afternoon tea to make you feel like a real Brit.

programme.title: Wildest Places
programme.sub-title: Wildest Places S03 E01 - Outback Deserts NB
programme.desc: Australia’s vast interior is dry: nearly a fifth is classified as desert. With little rainfall and temperatures soaring above 50 degrees Celsius, it’s an unrelenting habitat. But these arid areas are also surprisingly varied, and can be breathtakingly spectacular.

programme.title: Wildest Places
programme.sub-title: Wildest Places S03 E02 - Rainforests NB
programme.desc: Some of the world’s most ancient and ecologically diverse rainforests are in Australia: from the oldest tropical rainforest on earth, North Queensland’s Daintree, to the stunning central highlands of Tasmania in the far south.

programme.title: Wildest Places
programme.sub-title: Wildest Places S03 E03 - Bush NB
programme.desc: Australia’s semi-coastal interior is vastly referred to as ‘the bush’. These forested tracts are lush and varied, coloured by extraordinary landscapes and wildlife found nowhere else on the planet.

programme.title: Wildest Places
programme.sub-title: Wildest Places S03 E04 - Coast NB
programme.desc: Australia has more than 35,000 kilometers of coastline. From broad, sandy beaches to towering cliffs and mangrove swamps, Australia’s coast can be a strange mix of soil and sea; rainforest and reef.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S01 E01 - Canada - Ocean To Ocean NB
programme.desc: Friends Scott Wilson and Justin Lukach leave the 9-to-5 to travel the world for a year. But before they depart, they decide to explore their own country first. They rent an RV in Halifax and hit the road, camping all the way from the Atlantic to the Pacific Ocean.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: After landing in Jordan, Scott and Justin are greeted by their friend Ibrahim who is getting married in a few weeks. They spend a night in the desert with the Bedouins, travel to Petra and the gulf of Aqaba, all just in time for the big day.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E08 - Ethiopia - Saints And Snakes NB
programme.desc: Scott and Justin explore the spiritual side of Ethiopia. In Lalibella, they visit ancient churches carved entirely out of stone, and Justin tries teaching a class of school children some new words. They visit the castles in Gondor and the Church of Saint Mary of Zion, which claims to house the lost Ark of the Covenant. At the Debra Damos monastery, accessible only by climbing a rope up a sheer cliff, they share some difficult but hilarious conversation with a well-spirited monk, who has some poignant things to say about brotherhood and human origins.

programme.title: Epic Trails
programme.sub-title: Epic Trails S01 E03 - Fiji NB
programme.desc: Eric goes off the beaten path as he hikes from one remote village to the next through Fiji.

programme.title: Epic Trails
programme.sub-title: Epic Trails S01 E04 - New Zealand NB
programme.desc: Eric Hanson explores the world-renowned Abel Tasman National Park by foot, and by sea kayak.

programme.title: Rock The Park
programme.sub-title: Rock The Park S05 E21 - Top 10 Volcano Adventures
programme.desc: Colton and Jack discover the explosive power of volcanoes as they count down their Top 10 volcano adventures. Included: The Yellowstone super volcano, a plunge into Crater Lake, and a hike up the world’s largest volcano.

programme.title: Rock The Park
programme.sub-title: Rock The Park S05 E22 - Best Of Road Trip Adventures NB
programme.desc: Colton and Jack hit the road as they relive their favorite road trip memories, including wild encounters in the Badlands, challenging conditions in Nevada, and breathtaking beauty in the Guadalupe Mountains.

programme.title: Rock The Park
programme.sub-title: Rock The Park S05 E23 - Best Of The West NB
programme.desc: Jack and Colton are looking back on some of their best adventures in the wild west. Included: Hiking to the top of the Continental Divide, exploring a mystery in Death Valley, and scuba diving a kelp forest in the Channel Islands.

programme.title: Rock The Park
programme.sub-title: Rock The Park S05 E24 - Best Of Wild Alaska NB
programme.desc: The most remote state in the U.S. never disappoints - from the rapids of Aniakchak, to the “white thunder” of Glacier Bay, to the sled dogs of Denali. Join Colton and Jack as they revisit their most epic and wild Alaskan adventures.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S10 E05 - 48 Hours In Iceland NB
programme.desc: Returning after an enforced minibreak of its own, Travel Man is back with new host Joe Lycett for a supersized Christmas special. For his maiden voyage Joe’s gone to Iceland with comedian and dance champion Bill Bailey.

programme.title: American Canvas
programme.sub-title: American Canvas S01 E02 - Austin NB
programme.desc: Dave Holmes dives into Austin’s eclectic culture—from contemporary outdoor art and punk rock markets to tailgating, tech-driven creativity, and gospel brunches—celebrating the quirky, soulful spirit that makes the Live Music Capital truly unique.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali
programme.sub-title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S01 E03 Tumeric
programme.desc: Journey alongside Lauren as she delves into the vibrant world of turmeric. From infusing it into dishes like Urap Pakis to crafting a healthful elixir called Jamu, discover the captivating flavors against the breathtaking backdrop of Mount Agung.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali
programme.sub-title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S01 E04 Nut
programme.desc: Join Lauren on a culinary adventure with various nuts as she discovers their potential beyond snacking and incorporates them into Italian and Balinese recipes like Cashew cheese, mouthwatering Cabonara and more delightful flavors.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.sub-title: Race Across The World S01 E03 - Stranded, Storms, And Silk Roads NB
programme.desc: From Baku to Tashkent, the journey intensifies as four teams cross the Caspian Sea, weather a fierce storm, and traverse the deserts of Central Asia. With limited transport, deepening rivalries, and emotional reckonings, bonds are tested and strategies challenged. From camel farms to ancient cities along the Silk Road, each leg reveals breathtaking landscapes—and the harsh reality of racing across the unknown.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.sub-title: Race Across The World S01 E04 - Borders, Bullet Trains And Big Risks NB
programme.desc: The race heats up as teams push across Kazakhstan into China, navigating border closures, sleepless trains, and emotional crossroads. Darren and Alex extend their lead but face personal tensions. Josh and Felix pursue inspiration and altitude, while Natalie and Shamima savor hard-won milestones. As the Great Wall looms and budgets thin, every decision could tip the scales in this epic global dash.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: Kentucky Lake / Marshall County Kentucky: A Big Dam Adventure
programme.desc: Located in the western corner of the state, Kentucky Lake is one of the largest man-made lakes in the world. In this episode we learn about the dam that made the lake and the ghost towns that lie beneath it. We’ll visit the Dam Brew Haus and try local beers, learn how to wake surf, play some mini-golf with some unique animals, try local cuisine at Belew’s Dairy Bar and wrap up with a sampling of over 30 beers at the inaugural Old Beach Craft Beer Bash.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.sub-title: Road Trip Masters: Pocono Mountains, PA Part 2
programme.desc: (Part 2 of 2) Brian and Nick hit the waters of the Lehigh and then feast on the most expensive steak in the world. They also visit a place that was the inspiration for Disney's haunted mansion!

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Adventure All Stars is the world’s only socially conscious travel show – an inspiring series that combines adventure and philanthropy. Cast members travel to secret locations, to uncover the best and most exciting experiences on the planet! Pre-filming all cast members raise funds for their favorite charitable cause, and their reward is the trip-of-a-lifetime. The show contributes more to charity than any other Australian television series, and is now one of the biggest donors to philanthropy of any TV show in the world (almost $10 Million).

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 1: El Sacrificio de Rosalinda y Gabriel
programme.desc: Rosalinda es feliz al comprobar que su sacrificio no ha sido en vano y que está cosechando sus enormes campos de pomarrosas para la felicidad de su hija Marisela. Gabriel con algunos de sus amigos llega a la hacienda que acaba de comprar su padre para realizar una inspección ayudado por Fernando pero también para divertirse y es así que decide marcharse con sus amigos a visitar la cascada que tanto le han señalado y alabado como insuperable y piensa que se ha librado al menos por un rato de su celosa novia, sin sospechar que ésta está a punto de aterrizar en la avioneta que está llegando a la hacienda según ella para sorprenderlo

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 44: Dileidy Revela Su Verdadera Vida
programme.desc: Luís Fernando le dice a Dileidy que le importa mucho y que ella no vive en el edificio donde dice vivir. Ella le evade lo dicho y se aleja. Luego Luís Fernando persigue a Dileidy hasta donde vive, Dileidy cerca de donde vive habla con un buhonero y con Doroteo, Luís Fernando la ve de lejos y le extraña que ella viva por esa zona. Yenilú se percata de que Luís Fernando anda por ahí y le dice a Gerson que entretenga a Luís Fernando como para que se vaya de ahí. Luego ella aborda a Dileidy y ésta se da cuenta que Gerson persuade a su novio. Luego de que Luís F. Se va Gerson le dice que su cuñao le cayó bien y que por ella hasta pudo haber perdido su carro. Gabriel va donde Gladis pero ésta ya no quiere nada con él, dice a Yuraima que no sirve para entrometerse en matrimonios. Marco le pide a Doroteo que pinte su casa y que tendrá que sacar copia de la llave porque vive solo y para que pinte tranquilo. Doroteo ve la oportunidad de tener una casa sola para llevar a Maria Antonia. Pascuita cuando le cuenta a la nena de que su millonario lo vio de pintor y Eglée lo había visto de mariachis no le cree, en eso Doroteo la llama y le dice que no puede verla porque “cuadra negocios en Maturín” cuando en verdad va a pintar ahora es la casa de marco. La nena esperanzada espera a lo que ella piensa es un millonario. Rómulo y Eglée cada uno con su respectivo abogado discuten lo de la separación de bienes, Rómulo da su llave de la casa y Egleé está de acuerdo en que a él le queden algunos muebles para cuando se mude., Rómulo no pone resistencia en cumplir con su deber con sus hijos. Luís Fernando llega y dice que tuvo una experiencia como de un atraco pero no fue así. Remedios visita a Gladis y fue como para que supiese que Gabito es de ella pero luego que se va Gladis le dice a su hija que ella fácil le podría tumbar a Gabito pero que no lo hace por lastima. Egleé celebra su próximo divorcio de lo mas feliz a pesar de que a Pascuita le parezca que va a quedarse sola, vieja y gorda. Rómulo por su parte le dice a José que se le acabó su vida porque él no sabe vivir sin Egleé.

programme.title: Las Amazonas
programme.desc: Emiro Lizárraga es un ambicioso y orgulloso propietario de un rancho de caballos llamado Amazonas. Emiro obtuvo su fortuna por medios ilegales, y tiene tres hijas Isabel, Carolina y Eloísa, además de haberse casado recientemente con su secretaria Elvira, una mujer coqueta, calculadora y ambiciosa. Las niñas no se llevan bien con la nueva esposa de su padre, lo que provoca conflictos. Isabel, la hija mayor, se siente atraída por Rodrigo, un joven veterinario divorciado y con dos hijas

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: La Viuda Negra ataca a Iris y la deja tirada en el ascensor hasta que viene Simón y la ayuda. No la mata pero le dice que se aleje de Simón porque si no la próxima no la cuenta. Ella piensa que fue Christian quien la atacó. Inmaculada estaba logrando seducir a Alejandro pero este se da cuenta que lo que está haciendo está mal y se va de la casa. Christian saca del apartamento a su ex Grecia que está muy enojada porque se encontraba con Vicenta. Luego Grecia le cuenta a Ivana lo ocurrido y esta entiende lo de la inseminación. Se encuentran en el entierro de Tomás Rulfo y su hermano enojado ataca a la Baronesa porque le echa la culpa de la muerte, pero Jeremías la protege.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 1: El Desmayo, Boda y Herencia Millonaria
programme.desc: Es la noche más esperada para las candidatas mundiales de la belleza y Socorro “Coco” Alvarez Castillo, la actual reina, le entrega la corona a su sucesora. Josefina, su madre, la acompaña. Un desmayo ficticio de Socorro, planeado por Josefina, la convierte en el tema de todos los noticieros, robándole importancia a la nueva reina. Y para continuar con las victorias, Felipe, el novio de Socorro, le propone matrimonio. El “sí” de Socorro le permitirá obtener 40 millones de dólares. La herencia que su abuela Agustina prometió entregarle en vida, si se casaba.

Ella piensa que fue Christian quien la atacó. Inmaculada estaba logrando seducir a Alejandro pero este se da cuenta que lo que está haciendo está mal y se va de la casa. Christian saca del apartamento a su ex Grecia que está muy enojada porque se encontraba con Vicenta. Luego Grecia le cuenta a Ivana lo ocurrido y esta entiende lo de la inseminación. Se encuentran en el entierro de Tomás Rulfo y su hermano enojado ataca a la Baronesa porque le echa la culpa de la muerte, pero Jeremías la protege.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 1: El Desmayo, Boda y Herencia Millonaria
programme.desc: Es la noche más esperada para las candidatas mundiales de la belleza y Socorro “Coco” Alvarez Castillo, la actual reina, le entrega la corona a su sucesora. Josefina, su madre, la acompaña. Un desmayo ficticio de Socorro, planeado por Josefina, la convierte en el tema de todos los noticieros, robándole importancia a la nueva reina. Y para continuar con las victorias, Felipe, el novio de Socorro, le propone matrimonio. El “sí” de Socorro le permitirá obtener 40 millones de dólares. La herencia que su abuela Agustina prometió entregarle en vida, si se casaba.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 1: El Sacrificio de Rosalinda y Gabriel
programme.desc: Rosalinda es feliz al comprobar que su sacrificio no ha sido en vano y que está cosechando sus enormes campos de pomarrosas para la felicidad de su hija Marisela. Gabriel con algunos de sus amigos llega a la hacienda que acaba de comprar su padre para realizar una inspección ayudado por Fernando pero también para divertirse y es así que decide marcharse con sus amigos a visitar la cascada que tanto le han señalado y alabado como insuperable y piensa que se ha librado al menos por un rato de su celosa novia, sin sospechar que ésta está a punto de aterrizar en la avioneta que está llegando a la hacienda según ella para sorprenderlo

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 44: Dileidy Revela Su Verdadera Vida
programme.desc: Luís Fernando le dice a Dileidy que le importa mucho y que ella no vive en el edificio donde dice vivir. Ella le evade lo dicho y se aleja. Luego Luís Fernando persigue a Dileidy hasta donde vive, Dileidy cerca de donde vive habla con un buhonero y con Doroteo, Luís Fernando la ve de lejos y le extraña que ella viva por esa zona. Yenilú se percata de que Luís Fernando anda por ahí y le dice a Gerson que entretenga a Luís Fernando como para que se vaya de ahí. Luego ella aborda a Dileidy y ésta se da cuenta que Gerson persuade a su novio. Luego de que Luís F. Se va Gerson le dice que su cuñao le cayó bien y que por ella hasta pudo haber perdido su carro. Gabriel va donde Gladis pero ésta ya no quiere nada con él, dice a Yuraima que no sirve para entrometerse en matrimonios. Marco le pide a Doroteo que pinte su casa y que tendrá que sacar copia de la llave porque vive solo y para que pinte tranquilo. Doroteo ve la oportunidad de tener una casa sola para llevar a Maria Antonia. Pascuita cuando le cuenta a la nena de que su millonario lo vio de pintor y Eglée lo había visto de mariachis no le cree, en eso Doroteo la llama y le dice que no puede verla porque “cuadra negocios en Maturín” cuando en verdad va a pintar ahora es la casa de marco. La nena esperanzada espera a lo que ella piensa es un millonario. Rómulo y Eglée cada uno con su respectivo abogado discuten lo de la separación de bienes, Rómulo da su llave de la casa y Egleé está de acuerdo en que a él le queden algunos muebles para cuando se mude., Rómulo no pone resistencia en cumplir con su deber con sus hijos. Luís Fernando llega y dice que tuvo una experiencia como de un atraco pero no fue así. Remedios visita a Gladis y fue como para que supiese que Gabito es de ella pero luego que se va Gladis le dice a su hija que ella fácil le podría tumbar a Gabito pero que no lo hace por lastima. Egleé celebra su próximo divorcio de lo mas feliz a pesar de que a Pascuita le parezca que va a quedarse sola, vieja y gorda. Rómulo por su parte le dice a José que se le acabó su vida porque él no sabe vivir sin Egleé.

programme.title: Las Amazonas
programme.desc: Emiro Lizárraga es un ambicioso y orgulloso propietario de un rancho de caballos llamado Amazonas. Emiro obtuvo su fortuna por medios ilegales, y tiene tres hijas Isabel, Carolina y Eloísa, además de haberse casado recientemente con su secretaria Elvira, una mujer coqueta, calculadora y ambiciosa. Las niñas no se llevan bien con la nueva esposa de su padre, lo que provoca conflictos. Isabel, la hija mayor, se siente atraída por Rodrigo, un joven veterinario divorciado y con dos hijas

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Inmaculada estaba logrando seducir a Alejandro pero este reacciona y se da cuenta que hizo lo incorrecto y se va de la casa. Josué ayuda en el apartamento de Domingo a Pelusa y le dice que tiene que denunciar al Peludo, que es un tipo muy peligroso por todo el destrozo que había hecho pero ella no le hace caso pues piensa que el Peludo no hizo eso. Christian habla con Vicenta y le deja bien en claro que si no le ayuda a recuperar las acciones que Ivana le robó a su padre no le dará el divorcio. Abril le lleva la cena a Alejandro al trabajo mientras él piensa en los besos que le había dado a Inmaculada.

programme.title: Episodio 2: La Farsa del Matrimonio Millonario
programme.desc: Socorro se desmaya al ver a Salvador en la habitación del hotel donde debería estar su madre. Josefina aprovecha para salir del lugar sin ser descubierta. Al despertar, Socorro piensa que se equivocó y se disculpa con Salvador, quien le miente diciéndole que su novia, pudorosa, está escondida en el baño. Socorro sale en búsqueda de Josefina y juntas, enfrentan a Felipe, quien les ofrece un millón de dólares por mantener la farsa del matrimonio ante su abuela Agustina. Josefina aprovecha la oportunidad y a cambio le pide 20 millones de dólares. Felipe, obligado por las circunstancias, acepta ceder la mitad de su herencia.

programme.title: Episodio 2: El sepelio de Rosalinda y la desgracia
programme.desc: Fernando está desesperado ha visto morir a la mujer que tanto ama y se asombra cuando ve llegar a Marisela y no puede creer lo que está viendo. Cuando llega Eloy Gabriel está socorriendo a Isadora quien supuestamente ha tenido un desmayo pero que se despabila de inmediato cuando el peón habla de una desgracia en la hacienda, Gabriel corre en busca de Fernando pero cuando Eloy va de salida sentencia que quien mató a la culebra es el responsable de esa desgracia. Se realiza el sepelio de Rosalinda y Marisela recibe el apoyo de todos sus vecinos que la acompañan en tan triste momento, Gabriel también se apersona por allí y Fernando sufre y se pasea alrededor del lugar tratando se superar su dolor

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Cristina, drogada, entra a la fuerza a casa de Víctor, donde Mónica la enfrenta. Furiosa, la periodista le dice a Rutila que se vengará. Leonor no resistiría estar de nuevo presa, y Omar le propone huir.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Desesperada, Mónica le pide ayuda a Omar para huir con su hijo, luego de confesarle a doña Alba que Aurelio es culpable de la muerte de Isabel. Morejón acusa a Ignacio del atentado a Monteverde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de una noche de amor con Rutila, el Chema sale de su madriguera para ayudar a Feyo, sin imaginar los planes de Rivero. Mónica convence a Omar para que vaya a la cita con Ramiro Silva.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Omar está aterrado al saber que Ramiro lo escogió para ser presidente de México y que recibirá órdenes de Aurelio. El Chema escapa y hiere a Rivero, mientras Leonor rescata a Rutila y a su hijo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los estudiantes son ejecutados por orden de Feyo, quien, junto con el Chema, busca matar a los Casillas. Aurelio entrega su imperio a Mónica y Víctor. Rutila encuentra el dinero para huir.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le cobra con sangre a Cristina su traición, y la mata frente a Esperanza, mientras le jura a Feyo que se vengará por lo que le hizo a Alba. Tim captura al general venezolano en Aruba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En un atentado organizado por Aurelio para levantar la candidatura de Omar, Ignacio mata a Leonor en un acto de campaña. Pasan dos años, la salud de Casillas se deteriora y reúne a su familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema y Feyo atacan a la familia Casillas y Luzma queda gravemente herida. Mónica está embarazada de Víctor, mientras él es víctima de una emboscada en Colombia, traicionado por Tijeras.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Para vengarse de Feyo, Aurelio visita en la cárcel a María Sol y lo llama para que escuche cuando la ahorca. Desesperado, Aguilera advierte que matará a todos los Casillas. Javi salva a Víctor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Esperanza le ofrecen dinero a Amparo por el riñón de Carlitos, pero ella se niega. Mónica busca a Víctor y le dice a Casillas que está embarazada. Omar necesita saber quién mató a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Con ayuda del Oficial, Feyo se propone matar a Casillas y descubrir quiénes son sus aliados. Aurelio y Esperanza quieren seducir a Amparo. Omar pide a Ignacio averiguar quién le disparó a Leo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica tiene un mal presentimiento y pide a Javi que la ayude a sacar a Víctor de la selva. El Oficial se propone matar al Chema, mientras Ernestina informa a Ramiro que Aurelio está enfermo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Oficial y el Reyecito atacan con bazucas al Chema, quien jura venganza tras escapar. Furioso llama a Feyo y le dice que es el primero en su lista. Rutila llega con su hijo a casa de Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Ingeniero le dice a Torito que la era del Chema terminó, mientras Eleazar habla con Venegas para eliminar al Oficial, el Reyecito y Tijeras. Ramiro, interesado en Amparo, le ofrece trabajo.

programme.title: Huellas de Navidad
programme.desc: Un veterano militar busca un propósito en su vida después de que una lesión truncara su carrera. Lo encuentra en una amable mujer que dirige un refugio de animales. Mientras trabajan juntos para encontrar hogares par los animales durante la temporada navideña de adopciones, desarrollan sentimientos mutuos y se ayudan mutuamente con los retos a los que cada uno se enfrenta.

programme.title: La Bella y el Billonario

programme.title: Diseñado con Amor
programme.desc: La diseñadora Skye se desplaza con un "camión de la moda", pero no puede hacerlo sola. La ayuda llega en forma del apuesto empresario Jason. Mientras trabajan juntos, Skye y Jason descubren que tienen más en común de lo que pensaban; ¿podría ser amor?

programme.title: Rosas de Navidad
programme.desc: Una niña que lucha con el dolor y una mujer solitaria que se ha aislado del mundo ven sus vidas entrelazarse inesperadamente. A medida que la magia de la Navidad recorre sus corazones, descubren que el amor, el perdón y las segundas oportunidades son los mejores regalos de todos.

programme.title: Navidad con Un Príncipe: El Bebé Real
programme.desc: Las cosas se complican para el futuro Príncipe Alexander y la Dra. Tasha cuando se planea una visita de Estado real al extranjero, pasando por su ciudad natal. Un ligero susto retrasa su regreso, y la pareja debe luchar para desafiar la tradición y cumplir, literalmente, con las expectativas.

programme.title: La Receta Del Amor
programme.desc: Una ocupada cirujana regresa a casa para celebrar que su padre se ha convertido en alcalde. Pero tras un encuentro fortuito con el único médico del pueblo -y el soltero más codiciado-, es testigo de una verdadera compasión que podría ser la receta que este médico necesita.

programme.title: Luces, Cámara, Romance
programme.desc: La actriz Emma Hutton está decidida a ayudar a encontrar a su amiga Hope como pareja perfecta, pero al hacerlo, accidentalmente pisotea varios corazones. Cuando Emma se da cuenta de que ella misma siempre ha amado a su buen amigo Gray, Emma aprende que el amor funciona mejor cuando no se entromete en él. Un romance encantador inspirado en "Emma" de Jane Austen.

programme.title: Barney and Friends

This important lesson prompts Barney to teach his friends essential safety rules. Spending time with Barney is always enjoyable, but it's also crucial to learn how to play it safe to stay protected and happy!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney and his friends begin the day by playing hopscotchwith a twist. They discover that making a triangle requires 3 lines and 3 corners, which sparks their excitement to explore more shapes. To have even more triangle fun, Barney takes them on a camping trip where they get to explore and learn about different shapes in the world around them.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Its the day of the bike parade, but Nick has had a bike accident that leaves his bike in need of repair by Mr. Boyd. Mr. Boyd works quickly to help fix Nick's bike in time for the parade. While waiting, Barney takes the opportunity to teach his friends all about bike safety, making sure they're ready to ride safely and have a great time in the parade!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: After the kids discuss their desire for a special day, Beth creates Happy Day, a special holiday in which each friend makes a wish and the others try to make it come true. When Beth hurts herself, BJ learns the importance of doing good deeds for others.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney plans a magical picnic for his friends and their families to spend quality time together and create lasting memories. Each kid has brought a family treasure to show Barney, which they all excitedly spend time sharing with one another.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: The kids gather at the park, talking about how hot it is and wondering what to do on such a day. Thanks to Barney's brilliant idea, what starts as a too hot afternoon turns into a totally cool day as he introduces them to the wonders of water. Excitedly, they all team up to find creative ways to stay cool and have a splashing good time together!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Even though the park feels like a second home for Barney and his friends, BJ dreams of building his very own totally awesome, completely cool house. While they eagerly wait to see it, they start talking about the different rooms a house can have. However, when BJ forgets to include a space for Baby Bop in his plans, Barney reminds him that family is what truly makes a house feel like a home.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Mr. Boyd excitedly tells Barney and the kids about the upcoming arrival of a brand-new fountain for the park! While they eagerly await the special delivery, Barney and the children make the most of their time by enjoying the park's delights. They swing on the swings, admire the beautiful flowers, and create wonderful memories together, all while looking forward to the fountain's grand entrance.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ is pretending to be a great detective, and needs a mystery to solve! A case quickly comes his way when something nibbles on one of Baby Bops healthy snacks. BJ, Barney, and Baby Bop uncover several clues along the way and soon realize the culprit is someones pet rabbit. Barney sees Riff protecting a nest full of duck eggs. Together, they leave the eggs to look for food for when the ducklings hatch. When they return, Riff is pleasantly surprised to find the eggs have cracked open and the baby ducklings have hatched!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: While playing in the caboose, BJ is surprised to learn that The Land of Mother Goose truly exists. Several Mother Goose characters have come to ask for help; parts of their rhymes are missing! Mother Goose arrives and fixes the problem, and all of the Mother Goose characters return home. BJ and Baby Bop hope to visit them soon. When Baby Bop catches Barney, BJ, Riff and some children wrapping a mysterious present in the caboose, she just cant wait to see what is in the box. Barney suggests they listen to a story while they wait. Baby Bop finally gets to open her present and realizes that sometimes waiting is a good thing!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop isnt satisfied with the things she can do. She wants to play the keyboard like Riff and wants to be able to skate like Barney. Nobody can cheer her up, until she unexpectedly gets the whole park dancing and she realizes there are things she can do, too! When a wheelchair-bound child is unintentionally neglected by his friends, Barney steps in to help. He gently reminds the others to include the child by showing them that even Barney feels excluded sometimes. It isnt always easy being a big, purple dinosaur. In the end, everyone is included for a day of fun!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Jamal has never danced before and is too shy to try. On the day of the big dance party in the park, Barney and his friends introduce Jamal to many kinds of dance. Barney assures Jamal that he can do anything he puts his mind to even dance. With Barneys help, Jamal finally finds his groove and has fun dancing with his friends! Barney tells Baby Bop the story of The Princess Without a Song to Sing. In this original fairytale, Baby Bop imagines herself as the sad little princess trying to find her unique song. Barney, BJ and Riff all become characters in the story, each sharing their songs and revealing an element of song, sound, rhythm and feeling. With their help, the princess finds her song and is delighted to sing it for her friends!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Riff cant find his drumsticks anywhere. He knows he had them when he visited various neighborhood locations with Barney earlier in the day. Barney magically recreates neighborhood spots to help refresh Riffs memory. Happily, Barneys strategy is a success and Riff finds his drumsticks. Along the way, everyone learns that the most important part of a neighborhood is the people who live there! Barney helps Baby Bop explore many different jobs. At the end of the day, Baby Bop has several different careers to consider for when she grows up. But for now, shes happy just being three!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ is waiting for a very special letter from his pen pal in China. The letter reveals that his pen pal is coming for a visit. With the help of friends in the park, BJ hurries to get the park ready. He wants it decorated so his pen pal feels right at home. BJ soon learns that his pen pal wants to see how BJ really lives! Everyone is anxiously awaiting Mrs. Matumas Harambee Dance Troupe to arrive. They finally arrive and perform a show of African music and dance and everyone pulls together in the true spirit of Harambee!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney is snacking on pistachios...and just can't seem to stop! His friends try to help. An unexpected avalanche of pistachios convinces Barney that his friends may be right. BJ is looking to find players for his baseball team. When his baseball-impaired cousin Riff asks to play, BJ is faced with a difficult choice. Barney helps BJ discover the meaning of team sports, friendships, and winning.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: In her eagerness to play with her friends, Baby Bop forgets to say please and thank you. Barney tells her that these two words can be magic. Baby Bop daydreams she can't say the magic words, no matter how hard she tries! Then Riff invents a robot to clean up the park. When Riff's Litterbot malfunctions, it creates even more trash to clean up.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When Baby Bop becomes a little bossy playing with her friends, Barney teaches her that being bossy isn't a nice way to treat your friends. Melanie has never been on a campout and is feeling nervous. When Barney tells her all about the fun they will have, Melanie decides to give it a try. What could be better than sharing her very first campout with her friends and Barney?

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: Little Red Rockin Hood - The Whole Truth
programme.desc: Baby Bop is having a hard time finding a story she hasn't heard before. Barney and the dinos decide to tell her an old story with a new twist...by singing Little Red Riding Hood! A talented young artist is painting a portrait of Barney, but when she steps away, BJ takes credit for it. When the others beg him to teach them to paint, BJ admits the truth and learns that honesty is the best policy!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Wind and the Sun - The Nature of Things
programme.desc: Baby Bop sets up a lemonade stand, but BJ wants to fly his kite in the same spot, leading to a heated debate over sun vs. wind. Barney shares the story of The Wind and the Sun, teaching them that kindness always prevails. Rachel carelessly litters in the park. Later on, she has a dream about animals who talk. With Barney and the animals help, Rachel learns that the park is home to many. Rachel realizes the importance of nature and of keeping our earth clean!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: After Riff makes friends with new kid Noah, BJ becomes jealous and thinks he is not Riff's friend anymore. Barney teaches him that you can always keep your old friendships and make new ones too. Barney and the kids are excited that they are going to the movies. But Ryan's Grandpa is coming to town, and he wants to spend some time with him. Arriving at the park, Ryan's Grandpa is looking for a very rare bird and he asks everyone to help him find it.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop wants Barney, BJ, and the kids to play with her instead of working in their garden. They promise to play with her as soon as they finish. Baby Bop can't wait, and tries many ways to get them to come play with her now, none of which work. When her friends do come to play, they have a tea party and enjoy some of the fresh things from the garden. When Riff hears a mysterious sound in the park, he plays detective, trying to solve the mystery. Barney and the children join in the fun. Along the way, they explore the sense of sound while identifying sounds of nature and the neighborhood.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: Lost and Found - Pot Full of Sunshine
programme.desc: After BJ loses everyone's tickets to the circus, he sets out to find them and learns a valuable lesson about responsibility. Baby Bop discovers a lonely little flower struggling to grow in a shady spot. She takes it to a sunny spot, nurtures it, and is thrilled when the flower blooms. When the flower dies on a cold day, Barney and friends help her gain hope for the future.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: Way to Go! - A Travel Adventure
programme.desc: When Baby Bop finds out that Daniel is going on a trip the next day, she wants to go on a trip as well. Everyone decides to pretend to travel the same way Daniel will travel. First, they all make cardboard cars out of some scrap boxes. Next, everyone pretends to be an airplane. Then Barney turns the cardboard airplanes into a great big cardboard bus. They go on a camera safari only to discover the last mode of their transportation--a big cardboard cruise ship.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Misbegotten Moon - A Space Adventure
programme.desc: After noticing parts of the moon are missing in the night sky, Baby Bop is determined to find the rest of it. It's up to Barney and the kids to help Baby Bop take a trip to outer space where they meet Mr. Moon. Baby Bop then learns that the moon is not always full at night.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Sword in the Sandbox - A Storybook Adventure
programme.desc: Daniel fails miserably when he tries to join the others in jump rope. Convinced that he's too little to do anything right, Barney tells him the story of The Sword in the Sandbox. Through the legend of King Arthur, Daniel learns there are many things he can do... if he tries hard enough.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: Riff to the Rescue! - A Wild West Adventure

programme.title: Barney and Friends

Barney and friends pitch in to help, but they all have different ideas about what kind of movie to make. Everything they try falls apart. When Barney reads the story of Aladdin and the Magic Lamp, Layla is transported to a Middle Eastern marketplace where she learns different cultures have many exciting foods and customs to offer.

programme.title: Barney and Friends

BJ knew he couldn't really jump that high, but he could jump high enough to save Emma's balloon. Everyone was proud of him, even if he couldn't jump over the moon. BJ was a hero.

programme.title: Barney and Friends

In the end, Baby Bop and Jill win the trophy for hopscotch and she and her mother leave.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Reluctant Dragon - A Fairy Tale Adventure
programme.desc: After the kids judge a spider by its creepy looks, Barney tells them the story of The Reluctant Dragon where a shepherd became friends with a dragon, who was judged by her appearance.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop's friend Monty the butterfly passes through the park with a flock of friends on their way to Mexico. programme.desc: Barney's excited to find out that Rusty's family is adopting a new baby sister from China; however, Rusty's not sure if he's going to be a good brother, and he doesn't know much about China. By the time he returns to the park, Rusty excitedly meets his new baby sister, named Mei Ling, and realizes he will be the best big brother ever.
